name: Cosmos Pharmaceutical Corp
summary: COSMOS Pharmaceutical Corporation engages in the retail sale of pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, daily necessities, and food products in Japan. The company offers general medicines, energy drinks, oral and nursing care products, vitamins, health foods, diet foods, and prescriptions; and hair care and bath products. It also provides baby products, detergents, insect repellents, air fresheners, bath and toilet products, cooking supplies, gardening supplies, household and cleaning supplies, and clothing; processed foods, daily necessities, seasonings, confectionery, beverages, and alcohol; and tobacco and other products. In addition, the company engages in the maintenance and management of buildings and commercial facilities, traffic control, and security contracting activities. It sells its products through retail stores and online. COSMOS Pharmaceutical Corporation was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.
